decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter builds directly on the firm's curing and seasoning know-how and its strategic organic focus, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the line rather than abandon it.

Organic poultry mini salami snacks are close to existing salami expertise and fit the organic expansion, though the single-variant snack format in a niche poultry segment carries somewhat higher risk of delisting.
The premium sharing salami snack line leverages established maturation and recipe knowledge and has its own web presence, allowing the firm to assimilate market feedback and adjust variants.
